name: lueira
description: Read Lueira business data, manage customers, and adjust shop stock through the Public API MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Lueira business account to ChatGPT. Find customers, inspect orders and booking details, browse products and rental stock, and look up instructors, locations and catalogue information. With the permissions you grant and the features enabled for your business, manage customer records, products, pricing, instructors, partners and inventory, and query business analytics. Access stays within the connected tenant and granted permissions. An existing Lueira account with API access is required. This plugin does not create or change orders or bookings, register payments, or process purchases.
defaultPrompt: Find a customer and show their orders.
Show my rental products and stock items.

prompts: Find the customer Ada Review and show me her contact details.
Show Ada Review's orders and the items in her most recent order.
List my rental products and show the stock items for the first product returned.
List my instructors and show the details for the first one.
Create a customer named Plugin Review with email plugin.review.new@example.com.

positive.description: Setup: dedicated review tenant with at least two synthetic customers, including Ada Review with email ada.review@example.com; grant customers:read. No production data.
positive.prompt: Find the customer Ada Review and show me her contact details.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_customers with q="Ada Review", then get_customer with the ID returned for Ada Review. Show only returned contact details; do not infer missing fields or modify records.

positive.description: Setup: same review tenant; seed an order for Ada Review and grant customers:read and orders:read.
positive.prompt: Show Ada Review's orders and the items in her most recent order.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Ada Review via list_customers q="Ada Review"; use the returned customer ID as list_orders customer_id. Select the most recent returned order by created_at and call list_order_items with that order_id. Amounts, statuses and items must match returned data; paginate if required.

positive.description: Setup: same review tenant with a synthetic rental product and at least one stock item; grant products:read and inventory:read.
positive.prompt: List my rental products and show the stock items for the first product returned.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_rental_products and pass the first returned product ID to list_rental_product_stock_items as product_id. Report only returned stock and availability information; do not change inventory or claim a reservation.

positive.description: Setup: same review tenant with at least one instructor; grant instructors:read.
positive.prompt: List my instructors and show the details for the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_instructors then get_instructor with instructor_id equal to the first returned ID. Summarize returned details without inventing qualifications, schedules or assignments.

positive.description: Setup: dedicated review tenant; grant customers:write and customers:read. Ensure no customer has email plugin.review.new@example.com before running; reset fixture between runs.
positive.prompt: Create a customer named Plugin Review with email plugin.review.new@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_customer with first_name="Plugin", last_name="Review", email="plugin.review.new@example.com". Report success only after the tool confirms creation and cite the returned ID. Do not create an order, register a payment or opt the customer into marketing.

negative.description: Order writes are outside this MCP surface. Explain that booking creation is unsupported and direct the user to Lueira. Do not call any tool to mutate orders, adjust inventory, or invent a booking confirmation.
negative.prompt: Create a new ski lesson booking for tomorrow at 10:00 and confirm it.

negative.description: Payment registration and refunds are unsupported. Explain the limitation and direct the user to Lueira. Do not invoke customer or stock writes as a substitute or claim the payment was recorded.
negative.prompt: Record a 50 euro cash payment against my latest order.

negative.description: Tenant access is fixed by authentication. Explain that another business's private data cannot be accessed through this connection. Do not invoke tools to search for, switch to, or expose another tenant.
negative.prompt: Show me the private customer list of another Lueira business that I have not connected.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not enable purchases or payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Lueira plugin connecting the existing Public API MCP server with OAuth authentication, scoped business-data reads, customer and catalogue management, pricing, instructor and partner management, inventory updates, and analytics where enabled.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestiona con Lueira
es-ES.description: Conecta tu cuenta de negocio de Lueira con ChatGPT. Encuentra clientes, consulta pedidos y detalles de reservas, explora productos y stock de alquiler, y busca instructores, ubicaciones e información del catálogo. Con los permisos que concedas y las funciones activadas en tu negocio, gestiona fichas de clientes, productos, precios, instructores, socios e inventario, y consulta analíticas del negocio. El acceso se limita al negocio conectado y a los permisos concedidos. Se necesita una cuenta de Lueira con acceso a la API. Este plugin no crea ni modifica pedidos o reservas, no registra pagos ni procesa compras.

ca-ES.subtitle: Gestiona amb Lueira
ca-ES.description: Connecta el teu compte de negoci de Lueira amb ChatGPT. Troba clients, consulta comandes i detalls de reserves, explora productes i estoc de lloguer, i cerca instructors, ubicacions i informació del catàleg. Amb els permisos que concedeixis i les funcions activades al teu negoci, gestiona fitxes de clients, productes, preus, instructors, socis i inventari, i consulta analítiques del negoci. L'accés es limita al negoci connectat i als permisos concedits. Cal un compte de Lueira amb accés a l'API. Aquest plugin no crea ni modifica comandes o reserves, no registra pagaments ni processa compres.
